name_th: อ่าวมาหยา
why_avoid: Closed 2018-2022 due to ecosystem collapse from overtourism (5,000+ visitors/day). Reopened with strict caps. Even a 'good' day means cattle-line boats and timed visits.

name_th: เกาะพีพี
why_avoid: Tonsai village is a wall-to-wall bar/hostel grid. Beautiful from above; on the ground, mostly fire-shows for backpackers and chartered tour boats.

name_th: ป่าตอง
why_avoid: Bangla Road, jet-ski scams, sex-tourism vibe. The beach is mediocre after decades of overdevelopment.

name_th: ถนนข้าวสาร
why_avoid: Backpacker-trap caricature of Thailand. Scorpion skewers, fake IDs, $10 buckets. Authentic Bangkok is a 5-minute walk in any direction.

name_th: ตลาดน้ำดำเนินสะดวก
why_avoid: 100% staged for tour buses since the 1970s. Vendors have learned to charge tourist prices for souvenirs nobody local would buy.

name_th: วัดเสือ
why_avoid: Animal welfare violations documented repeatedly. The original Tiger Temple was raided in 2016 with dead cubs found. Avoid all 'pet a tiger' venues.

name_th: ฟูลมูนปาร์ตี้
why_avoid: Iconic for backpackers but environmentally devastating — beaches trashed monthly, multiple deaths/year. The rest of Phangan is gorgeous; skip the party.

name_en: Wat Pho / Grand Palace tour-bus rush
name_th: วัดโพธิ์/พระบรมมหาราชวัง (ช่วงพีค)
why_avoid: Worth seeing once, but go before 8am or you're shoulder-to-shoulder with cruise tours. Skip the gem-scam tuk-tuks waiting outside.

name_th: เมืองเก่าเชียงใหม่ (วันเดียวจบ)
why_avoid: The 12 temples in 1 day grand-tour misses what makes Chiang Mai special. Locals roll their eyes at Sunday Walking Street.

name_th: พัทยากลาง
why_avoid: Walking Street area is sex-tourism central. Beach water quality is poor.

name_th: เขาใหญ่ทัวร์เช้า-เย็น
why_avoid: Day-trip tours hit only Haew Suwat waterfall + a viewpoint, miss what makes the park UNESCO. Stay 2+ nights or visit Suan Phueng instead.

name_en: Wat Phra That Doi Suthep tour-bus rush
name_th: วัดพระธาตุดอยสุเทพ (ช่วงทัวร์)
why_avoid: The temple is real and worth respecting, but daytime is wall-to-wall buses + selfie sticks at the chedi viewpoint. If you must go, ride up before 7am for monks' morning chants — otherwise locals roll their eyes at the all-day rush.

name_en: Wat Rong Khun (White Temple) selfie queue
name_th: วัดร่องขุ่น (วัดขาว)
why_avoid: The bridge approach has a one-way human conveyor belt at peak hours. The art is genuinely interesting but the experience is a parking-lot queue — visit at 7am open or skip for less-photographed Lanna temples.

name_en: Wat Rong Suea Ten (Blue Temple) Insta-mob
name_th: วัดร่องเสือเต้น (วัดน้ำเงิน)
why_avoid: Modern temple built for the Insta crowd post-2016. The blue paint photographs beautifully but the visit is 15 minutes of jostling for the same angle — it is not a place of practice.

name_th: ถนนคนเดินปาย วันสุดสัปดาห์
why_avoid: Friday-Sunday nights the lane is shoulder-to-shoulder with Bangkok and Chinese tour vans. The original Pai vibe is intact mid-week or up the valley — pick those windows.

name_th: ทัวร์อยุธยาแบบเช้า-เย็น
why_avoid: The Buddha-head-in-the-tree spot at Wat Mahathat clears 80 buses a day and the tour-bus circuit hits 4 wats in 3 hours, missing the river temples entirely. Stay overnight or rent a bike instead.

name_th: อุทยานสุโขทัย ช่วงพระอาทิตย์ตก
why_avoid: Wat Mahathat at sunset gets a coordinated tour-bus crush — tripods 3-deep around the Buddha. The site is breathtaking at 6:30am or in the rain; pick those.

name_th: หาดเฉวง เกาะสมุย
why_avoid: Mid-island party strip — beach clubs, jet-ski touts, packed sand most months. Even the quiet pockets share a road with all the bars.

name_th: หาดทรายรี เกาะเต่า
why_avoid: Once a quiet diving cove, now a wall of bars and Open-Water dive shops. The diving is fine; the village experience is gone.

name_th: หาดไร่เลย์ ช่วงไฮซีซั่น
why_avoid: Dec-March the peninsula is wall-to-wall longtails and kayak rentals — the cliffs are still gorgeous but the beaches are not quiet by any definition. Tub Kaek and the Yao islands are the same coastline without the crush.

name_en: James Bond Island (Khao Phing Kan) tour boat
name_th: เกาะเจมส์บอนด์ (เขาตะปู)
why_avoid: The karst is famous but the visit is 20 minutes of trinket stalls on a tiny beach with 30 other speedboats. Phang Nga Bay's quieter coves are right next door.

name_th: วัดอรุณ ช่วงพระอาทิตย์ตก
why_avoid: The temple is real, but the across-the-river photo lanes (Eat Sight Story, The Deck) get blocked by Thai-dress rental photoshoots — wait time for the cliché shot can hit an hour. Sunrise from the same spot is empty.

name_th: น้ำตกเอราวัณ วันสุดสัปดาห์
why_avoid: Sat-Sun the day-tripper bus from Bangkok parks 200 visitors at each tier; fish-feeding-people videos are nice on TikTok and miserable in person. Weekday or skip to Sangkhlaburi's quieter waterfalls.

name_th: ทัวร์ยอดดอยอินทนนท์
why_avoid: Bus tours stop at the highest-point sign + the twin chedis and call it a day, missing the Kew Mae Pan ridge that is the actual experience of Inthanon. Drive yourself or hike.

name_th: ค่ายขี่ช้างแม่สา
why_avoid: Riding-and-show camps still operate up the Mae Sa valley despite years of welfare investigations. Genuine sanctuaries (no riding, no painting, no shows) exist; the curated camps off the main road do not qualify.

name_th: ทัวร์เยาวราชยามค่ำ
why_avoid: The headline night-food tours move 25 tourists between 4 well-rated stalls — the queue waits become the night. Walk one block off Yaowarat into the Talat Noi lanes and you have the same food without the chain.

name_th: เขาตะเกียบ
why_avoid: The Hua Hin tour add-on. Monkeys here are aggressive grabbers — bag-snatch incidents are routine, the temple itself is forgettable. Khao Sam Roi Yot's coast 60 km south is quiet and dramatic.

name_th: แหลมพรหมเทพ พระอาทิตย์ตก
why_avoid: Phuket's southern-tip sunset spot is on every tour itinerary — 500 visitors crowd a small cliff every evening. Beautiful colour, terrible vibe.

name_th: การแสดงช้างสุรินทร์
why_avoid: The annual show (3rd weekend of November) features tug-of-war and football games staged for tourist photos. The mahout culture is genuine and worth visiting; the show format is not. Stay with a Kuay family at Ban Ta Klang and skip the stadium.

name_th: เขาค้อ ช่วงรีสอร์ทแน่น
why_avoid: The Khao Kho ridge has been overbuilt with cookie-cutter cabin resorts and Insta cafes since 2018. Long weekends mean hour-long queues at every viewpoint. Phu Thap Boek further along the same range still has the cloud-sea without the bar lights.
